get.description: Read-only summary list. All authenticated roles require factory access; ADMIN can access any existing factory. Missing/inaccessible factories return the same 404. Sort: created_at DESC, id DESC; full PostgreSQL microsecond precision is retained in the cursor. Single-value filters combine with AND. No raw request, snapshot, artifact, note, lease or receipt. Each page uses repeatable-read for consistent case/head/provenance. stale compares original case basis with current head, including after its own commit. Opaque signed cursors bind actor/factory/status/mode; keep this scope on subsequent requests. Limit may change. Malformed, tampered, unsupported or scope-mismatched cursors return INVALID_CURSOR. No time expiry; signing-key rotation invalidates cursors. Every page rechecks authorization. Fixed data has no duplicated/missing items; pages are not a cross-request snapshot, so restart without a cursor when refreshing a changing dataset. has_more uses limit+1; next_cursor is null on final/empty pages. No total count.

error.message: VALIDATION_ERROR: missing/invalid/unknown/repeated query parameters or invalid limit. INVALID_CURSOR: cursor format, signature, version or scope error.

post.description:
OPERATOR, ENGINEER or ADMIN with factory access; inaccessible cases return 404.
APPROVE and REJECT require AWAITING_APPROVAL and never alter the published schedule. REJECT must not select a candidate.
COMMIT is a separate transport command, NOT a HumanDecisionType. It requires APPROVED, LIVE, the exact approved candidate/hash, and current basis.
This transport adapts command to canonical HumanDecisionRequest.decision and candidate_version to its expected_plan_version. The transport expected_plan_version instead fences OperationsHead.plan_version. expected_case_revision fences case state; Schedule.revision is a fourth independent value and is published unchanged.
All commands require snapshot and head tokens matching the case basis and current head. Publish stores the exact candidate schedule and increments head plan_version once.
Idempotency-Key is 1-128 printable non-space ASCII characters, scoped to factory + authenticated actor, shared with case creation and all commands/cases in that factory. Use a NEW key for each logical command. Same key/body returns the original 200 body with Idempotency-Replayed: true even after context/status changes; different body/command/case returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Authorization is rechecked before replay. Receipts have no expiry; failed transactions leave no receipt. Request property order is ignored; omitted and explicit fields are distinct.
Server owns actor, time, hashes and status. Unknown fields, MODIFY, replacement schedules, and actor/time input are rejected. Do not reuse the older frontend DTO with candidate_revision/reason.

get.description: Read-only factory-authorized history; missing/inaccessible cases return 404 DECISION_CASE_NOT_FOUND. after_sequence is exclusive, default 0; limit defaults to 100 and is bounded 1..200. Sort by sequence ASC, never timestamp. Sequence is unique per case and need not equal case_revision (worker heartbeat revisions can have no event). Continue or poll using meta.next_after_sequence, even when has_more=false; empty pages echo the supplied sequence. Actor kind/id and occurred_at are server-owned. HUMAN CASE_STATUS_CHANGED events for APPROVE/REJECT/COMMIT include command, recommendation_id, candidate_plan_id/version/hash, schedule_hash and head plan_version. REJECT has null candidate fields. APPROVE/REJECT report unchanged head version; COMMIT reports the new version. Publication schedule ID/basis/time are available in case meta.commit or current-schedule commit metadata. Worker transitions have SYSTEM actors and may omit command fields. Unknown event types expose an empty payload. Raw request/artifact/snapshot, notes and leases are excluded. Every page rechecks authentication/factory access. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid, unknown or repeated after_sequence/limit query parameters.
